title: The Cardinal Ministers
abilities: Once per turn, at the start of an Action Round in which your Investment Tile has any Diplomatic Action, that Action confers 1 extra DP for each of the following you control (max 3): Savoy, Sardinia, and each Prestige space in Spain and Austria.

title: John Law
abilities: At the end of each Peace turn, reduce your Debt by 1 (or 2, if you control any spaces in Scotland).

title: Court of the Sun King
abilities: The Award for Europe is worth 1 extra VP to you.
image: res://assets/cards/Card-FR Ministry 03 Court of the Sun King.png

title: Jacobite Uprisings
abilities: Once per turn, you may use MP to shift spaces in Scotland and/or Ireland. Once per turn, on a different Action Round, you may spend 3 MP to score 1 VP (max 4) for each FR-flagged such space and Jacobite Victory marker. Immediately remove this card from the game after BR play of the Papacy-Hanover Negotiations Ministry card, or after a Jacobite Defeat war result.

title: New World Huguenots
abilities: Once per turn, during a FR Action Round, place 1 Huguenots marker in one FR-flagged Territory in N. America or the Caribbean where there isn't one already. A Huguenots marker increases its space's CP cost by 1. It may be flipped once per game to reduce the EP cost of a Market in its Region by 1. It is permanently removed if its space becomes BR-flagged.

title: Choiseul
abilities: Once per turn, when taking a Military action, you receive 1 extra MP that you may spend on Bonus War TIles or deploying Squadrons (only). Once per turn, if you have a Squadron in North America, you may pay 2 MP to construct a new Squadron (instead of the usual 4).

title: Dupleix
abilities: The Awards for India, Cotton, and Spice are worth 1 extra TRP to you.

title: Pompadour & du Barry
abilities: The first time each Action Round that you exhaust an Advantage in Europe, gain 1 TRP.
image: res://assets/cards/Card-FR Ministry 13 Pompadour and Du Barry.png

title: Voltaire
abilities: When the Europe Award is given, gain 1 TRP for each multi-space country in which you control a Prestige space (max 3).

title: Turgot
abilities: The first Debt you take each Action Round is worth 1 extra Action Point, provided you have more Available Debt than the British.

title: North American Trade
abilities: If you control more Fur and Fish Markets (combined) than your opponent at the start of your Action Round, your Economic Major and Minor Actions are worth 1 extra EP. Refresh your Huguenots markers, if you have any on the map.

title: Marquis de Condorcet
abilities: Once per turn, at the start of your Action Round, you can play an Event even if your selected Investment Tile does not have an event symbol. You must still match the Event's type, if it has one, to the Major Action on the Investment Tile.

title: Lavoisier
abilities: On any Action Round you play an Event with a Bonus effect, and your receive that Bonus effect, your Major and Minor Actions from Investment Tiles are worth 1 extra Action Point.

title: Robert Walpole
abilities: Once per turn, your may draw one Event card, then discard one Event card.

title: Jonathan Swift
abilities: Spaces in Ireland and Scotland cost you 1 less DP to flag. If you control any spaces in Ireland, your Minor Diplomatic Actions may be used to remove FR flags in Europe.

title: East India Company
abilities: During the Scoring Phase, score 1 VP for each of the following unexhausted Advantages you control (maximum 3): Textiles, Silk, Fruit, Fur Trade, Rum.

title: Bank of England
abilities: Once per turn, you may increase your Debt Limit by 1. Once per turn, you may play an Economic event even if your selected Investment Tile does not have an Economic Major Action. (It still must have the Event symbol.)

title: Edmond Halley
abilities: Once per turn, you may spend 2 MP to build a Squadron (instead of the usual 4). Once per turn, if you have a Squadron in Europe, you may discard an Event card from your hand and take 1 TRP.

title: Pitt the Elder
abilities: Once per turn, when taking a Diplomatic action, you receive 1 extra DP that you may spend on shifting non-Prestige Political spaces. Once per turn, you may pay 2 MP to construct a new Squadron (instead of the usual 4).

title: Charles Hanbury Williams
abilities: Once per turn, FR-flagged spaces in Prussia, German States, and Russia cost you 1 less DP to unflag for one Action Round.

title: Merchant Banks
abilities: Ignore the first 2 Debt you take as EP each Peace turn, provided you use the Debt. (If this ability is available, you may use it even while at your Debt Limit.)

title: Samuel Johnson
abilities: The Award for Europe is worth 1 extra VP to you, and 1 less VP to France (minimum 0).

title: James Watt
abilities: If you are forced to take Debt in excess of your Debt Limit, your opponent scores no VP. The first time each Action Round your opponent exhausts an Advantage, gain 1 TRP.

title: Papacy-Hanover Negotiations
abilities: Remove the Jacobite Uprisings Ministry card from the game. Once per turn, when taking a Diplomatic action, you receive 2 DP usable only to shift spaces in Scotland and Ireland.

title: Townshend Acts
abilities: Once per turn, at the start of an Action Round, place the Townshend Acts marker on a commodity on the Global Demand display. You may use Minor Actions to unflag that commodity's Markets this turn.

title: Edmund Burke
abilities: Major Diplomatic Actions spent entirely in Europe are worth up to 2 extra DP: one for each Ireland space you control. Sons of Liberty and USA spaces cost 1 less DP for you to shift.
